name: spec2test
description: Manage Spec2Test projects, drop in specs and recordings, process them with the input-processor and review the results without leaving VS Code.

commands.title: Spec2Test: Add the Gherkin-Generator to this project
Spec2Test: Add files to the project…
Spec2Test: Show input in the sidebar

spec2test.port.description: Host port of the input-processor container (it listens on 8000 inside).

spec2test.autoStartService.description: Start the input-processor container automatically when the sidebar opens.

spec2test.image.inputProcessor.description: Docker image for the input-processor. Leave empty to use the image published for this version of the extension; set it to a local tag (for example spec2test-input-processor:dev) when developing.

spec2test.image.webCrawler.description: Docker image for the web crawler. Leave empty to use the image published for this version of the extension.

spec2test.webCrawler.enabled.description: Also run the web-crawler container, which the Gherkin-Generator agent uses to explore the application.

spec2test.webCrawler.port.description: Host port of the web-crawler container.

spec2test.gpu.description: Give the input-processor container access to NVIDIA GPUs (docker run --gpus all).

spec2test.dataFolder.description: Folder where Spec2Test keeps projects.json and the work area of every project (the folder the container mounts). Leave empty for ~/.spec2test. Use 'Spec2Test: Change the data folder…' to move your projects along with it.

spec2test.checkForUpdates.description: Once a day, look for a newer Spec2Test release on GitHub and offer to install it.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Spec2Test
walkthroughs.description: From an empty machine to your first processed spec.

steps.title: Install and start Docker
steps.description:
Spec2Test runs in Docker containers that the extension pulls and starts for you. The sidebar footer tells you what is missing and offers the next step.
[Open Spec2Test](command:spec2test.focus)

steps.title: Add an API key
steps.description: Open the Environment section and paste the key of the LLM provider you want to use. Keys are kept in your OS keychain and handed to the container when it starts.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.description: A project is a folder of inputs plus its own cache and pre-processed outputs.

steps.title: Drop files and process them
steps.description: Drop .mp4, .pdf, .md or .txt files into the drop zone, then press Process. Progress is live on every file card.
